svg.title: Tetsugan — Discipline of Iron. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Metal classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Tempered Stance forks into Folded Steel then Hammer and Anvil, or Resonant Parry then Every Blow Returned. Eye of Iron forks into Honed Edge then One Cut Decides, or Sparks from the Forge then Branding Iron. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Metal jutsu.

Tempered Stance answers \"How do I win defensively: endure the blow or send it back?\": Hammer and Anvil takes Decrease Damage Taken to 43/43/38%, and Every Blow Returned takes Harmonious Slash's Reflect 40 \u2192 50% as a bare payoff. The +2 lifts Phantom Slash 50 \u2192 52, the controlled payoff the director kept on Blood-Enchanted Eyes and Shakunetsu Sakura (RUL-2026-10-04-001/002). Branding Iron's exposure rider is +2% (route +4% on three rows): \u00d71.14 with the dagger, \u00d71.17 with every row up, level with One Cut Decides. Decrease Damage Taken: both stances \u00d70.77, just short of Blood-Enchanted Eyes' Deathless Vitality (\u00d70.75 over two rows); the third row (\u00d70.68) needs the staff as well as the sword and a third 60 AP cast, so with one weapon-style item the +8% fortress compounds on two rows. Afterburn has one row; Branding Iron stops at +10%. Reflect has one row and sits at its +10% ceiling (the one-row band); Every Blow Returned carries no rider, so the capstone never shrinks the hit Reflect reads (\u00d71.25 on a raw hit, \u00d71.18 under both suppression rows, where only Tempered Stance's +2% trims it).","Fourth purchases: One Cut Decides takes Tempered Stance (the same stance casts carry Decrease Damage Taken; the natural sword build) or Sparks from the Forge (Afterburn 38%, dagger only; \u00d71.19 with every row up). It is the payoff of a deliberate burst route (Honed Edge's +3% Increase Damage Given setup on the stances), the pattern the director kept on Blood-Enchanted Eyes (RUL-2026-10-04-001, Reaper's Embrace 50 \u2192 52) and Shakunetsu Sakura (RUL-2026-10-04-002, Sakura-ame 50 \u2192 52). No row passes 52; the 45 strikes stop at 47 and the 40 strikes at 42. Flagged for director confirmation.","design_review":{"status":"Fable proposal (2026-10-04 batch rebalance); not director-approved","foundation_sentences":{"06":"How do I win offensively: sharpen my own strikes or brand the enemy?","01":"How do I win defensively: endure the blow or send it back?"},"route_identities":{"08":"burst: hone the stances, then a controlled +2 Damage cut","10":"attrition: brand the target so every hit burns","03":"fortress: endure the blow","05":"retaliation: parry and send the blow back"},"director_review":"Confirm two consequences. (1) One Cut Decides' +2 lifts Phantom Slash 50 \u2192 52 (above the Nuke tier), following Blood-Enchanted Eyes and Shakunetsu Sakura (RUL-2026-10-04-001/002); the first-pass +8% Increase Damage Given route is withdrawn. (2) Hammer and Anvil keeps +8% Decrease Damage Taken on three rows, above the roster's three-row +5% convention, because the third row needs a second weapon-style item: both stances \u00d70.77 against Deathless Vitality \u00d70.75, all three rows \u00d70.68.","concerns":["Branding Iron + Honed Edge is the strongest all-offence allocation with every row up (\u00d71.25, against One Cut Decides + Sparks from the Forge \u00d71.19 and Blood-Enchanted Eyes' Feast of the Fallen + Opened Veins \u00d71.23 on the same model), but it needs the dagger and the sword at once (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G7) and six casts live together; with the dagger alone it is \u00d71.16.","One Cut Decides' +2 reaches all seven Metal strikes, wider than the director patterns (Blood-Enchanted Eyes four rows, Shakunetsu Sakura and Arashima two); the weapon gates hold one item to two or three strikes, and Equilibrium Guard Strike's line carries 47 to allies in it.","Hammer and Anvil's three-row case (\u00d70.68) still exceeds Blood-Enchanted Eyes' two-row fortress; it needs both the sword and the staff, and simultaneous wield was not read at the pin (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G7).","Every Blow Returned is a bare single-row payoff (Reflect 40 \u2192 50% on sword-gated Harmonious Slash, the one-row +10% band); its earlier +3% Decrease Damage Given rider was dropped because it shrank the hit Reflect reads. Tempered Stance's +2% still trims the return slightly (\u00d71.18 instead of \u00d71.25 under both suppression rows), and Folded Steel as the fourth is a deliberate return-for-survival trade (\u00d71.09 returned, \u00d70.87 taken with a stance up under both suppression rows)."]}}

g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Metal jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Inner Peace · Middle Guard Stance · Pivoting Fortress · Tranquil Guard
Equilibrium Guard Strike · Phantom Slash · Vacuum Fan
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
One Cut Decides path + Tempered Stance
Hammer and Anvil path + Eye of Iron
Every Blow Returned path + Folded Steel
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn · REF: Reflect
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE TETSUGAN KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Tranquil Guard Flowing Form · Decrease Damage Given
Middle Guard Stance · Increase Damage Given
Middle Guard Stance · Decrease Damage Taken
Equilibrium Guard Strike · Increase Damage Taken
Inner Peace · Increase Damage Given (each of 2 effects)
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Metal classification / forked tree
